summary.text: Brian Williams is a Democratic member of the Missouri Senate for District 14 in St. Louis County, serving since 2018 and as Minority Caucus Whip.

His official Senate page lists him as chair of the Progress and Development Committee and a member of Government Efficiency, Gubernatorial Appointments, and Rules, Joint Rules, Resolutions and Ethics.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Williams worked as a staffer in the U.S. Congress before entering the Senate and describes his legislation on criminal justice reform, including a use-of-force database and a statewide conviction review unit.
It says he sits on the Senate Appropriations Committee, serves on the board of People's Health Centers, and lives with his family in University City.
